About.title: About Us
About.intro1: CHABA is your trusted destination for luxury fragrances in Algeria, offering a carefully curated selection of the finest authentic Saudi and Turkish perfumes.
About.intro2: We believe a fragrance is an extension of who you are — that's why every piece reaches you 100% authentic, carefully packaged, and backed by a customer service team that cares about your experience from order to delivery.

values.title: Authenticity
values.body: Every product we offer is 100% authentic, from a trusted and guaranteed source.

values.title: Quality
values.body: We select our fragrances with great care to ensure an exceptional, lasting experience.

values.title: Customer Care
values.body: Our team is here to support you every step of the way, from choosing a product to after it arrives.

Contact.title: Contact Us
Contact.intro: We'd love to hear from you about our products or your order.
Contact.whatsappBody: The fastest way to reach us directly.
Contact.emailBody: For any general or business inquiry.
Contact.trackOrderBody: To follow up on an order you've already placed.

items.a: Delivery time varies by wilaya — the estimate is shown to you when you complete your order.

items.q: Do you deliver to every wilaya?
items.a: Yes, we deliver to all 58 wilayas of Algeria.
Yes, cash on delivery is available for every order, alongside other online payment options where available.

items.q: How can I be sure a product is authentic?
items.a: All of our products are 100% authentic from a trusted source, and every piece is guaranteed.

items.q: How do I track my order?
items.a: You can track your order at any time from the order tracking page using your order number and phone number.

items.q: Can I return or exchange a product?
items.a: Yes, according to the return policy detailed on the Shipping & Returns page.

items.q: Do I need an account to order?
items.a: No, you can check out as a guest, or create an account to follow your orders more easily.

Terms.title: Terms & Conditions
Terms.intro: Please read these terms and conditions carefully before using the CHABA store. Using the site or placing an order means you agree to them.

sections.b: By using this site or completing a purchase, you agree to be fully bound by these terms and conditions.
All prices shown are in Algerian dinars and include applicable taxes. We reserve the right to adjust prices or correct any obvious pricing error at any time before an order is confirmed.
We offer cash on delivery, plus online payment methods where available. All online payment data is handled securely by licensed payment providers.
Delivery is available to every wilaya in Algeria; fees and delivery time are calculated by wilaya when you complete your order.
An order may be returned or cancelled under the conditions described on the Shipping & Returns page.
You are responsible for keeping your account details confidential and for any activity that happens through it.
All content on this site — text, images, and logos — belongs to CHABA and may not be used without prior permission.
We reserve the right to update these terms at any time; continuing to use the site after a change means you accept it.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains how we collect and use your information.

sections.b: We collect the information you provide when creating an account or placing an order — such as your name, phone number, and address — along with basic site usage data.
We use your data to process your orders, communicate with you about them, and improve your experience on the store.
We only share your data with parties necessary to fulfill your order, such as delivery partners and payment providers, and we never sell your data to third parties.
The site uses essential cookies to remember your preferences, such as language and cart contents.
We take reasonable technical measures to protect your data from unauthorized access.
You can request to view or update your data, or delete your account, at any time by contacting us.

shippingSections.b: We offer home delivery, as well as pickup-point collection where available in your wilaya.
Delivery time and fees vary by wilaya and are shown clearly when you complete your order, before payment.
Once your order ships, you can track its status at any time from the order tracking page.

returnsSections.b: You may request a return or exchange within a set period after delivery, provided the product is unused and in its original condition.
The product must be in its original packaging, unused, with proof of purchase.
Once the returned product is received and its condition verified, your refund or exchange is processed within a few business days.
